name: Coinbase
description: Dry-run Coinbase trading engine for Crow: simulated rebalance and grid bots behind one order gateway with hard caps. Live trading is not enabled in this release.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: COINBASE_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Coinbase Advanced Trade API key. Optional in this release: trading is simulated.

env_vars.name: COINBASE_API_SECRET
env_vars.description: Coinbase Advanced Trade API private key, with its newlines written as \n. Optional in this release: trading is simulated.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_PORTFOLIO_ID
env_vars.description: ID of the Coinbase portfolio the engine's API key is scoped to. Not used while trading is simulated.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_ENGINE_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Bearer token Crow's MCP server and panel use to reach the engine's API on loopback. Generated by Crow at install; never shown.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_POLL_SECONDS
env_vars.description: Seconds between engine ticks (market read, fill check, reconcile).

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_MAKER_FEE_PCT
env_vars.description: Maker fee percent per fill. A grid step must clear twice this fee plus a margin.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_PRODUCTS
env_vars.description: Comma-separated Coinbase products the engine may trade, in dry-run only.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_DAILY_NOTIONAL_USD
env_vars.description: Hard cap on the total USD value of orders the engine may place per UTC day, across all products and owners.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_ORDERS_PER_HOUR
env_vars.description: Hard cap on orders the engine may place in any rolling hour, across all products and owners.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_PORTFOLIO_DRAWDOWN_PCT
env_vars.description: Portfolio drawdown percent from its high-water mark at which the engine halts all new orders until the halt is cleared.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_BOT_MAX_ORDER_USD
env_vars.description: Largest single order, in USD, a bot may place.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_MAX_BOT_CAPITAL_USD
env_vars.description: Largest starting capital, in USD, a new bot may be created with.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_AI_MAX_ORDER_USD
env_vars.description: Hard cap, in USD, on the value of a single order the AI may place.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_AI_DAILY_NOTIONAL_USD
env_vars.description: Hard cap on the total USD value of orders the AI may place per UTC day.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_AI_ORDERS_PER_HOUR
env_vars.description: Hard cap on orders the AI may place in any rolling hour.

env_vars.name: CROW_COINBASE_WATCHDOG_POLICY
env_vars.description: What the watchdog does when the engine's heartbeat goes stale: `leave` raises an alert only; `cancel` also cancels the engine's own open orders (those whose client order id starts with cb-).

notes: This release runs simulated trading only: orders are limit and post-only, and fills are simulated against public market data. Live trading is not enabled in this release. The engine refuses live mode in this release: a config that asks for it is refused at startup and the engine exits with code 3, which Docker's restart policy retries until the environment is fixed.
